ab: When dry, Agathaumas receives poor turning, but can sprint quicker with slower acceleration speeds, and ignores uphill movement speed penalties.
When Agathaumas is wet, it receives quicker acceleration and significantly better turning at the cost of slower sprint speed.

An equippable ability, where your Agathaumas will wallow to receive healing benefits such as faster health regeneration, and healing from ailments quicker such as bleed or venom based on how much mud is on you. When no mud is on you, you will gain bone break and fracture resistance
Muddy Scales Mud Amount Per Period
Shake to instantly dry off and remove salt and dehydration debuffs.

Among taking no extra damage from attacks to your head, Agathaumas has the ability to dive. This unique adaptation also increases its ability to see clearer underwater and during rainstorms. Additionally, swimming in water will replenish your thirst. Regardless if the water is freshwater, dirty, or salt water. Your thirst also decreases 50% slower when wet.
Adapted to wetland environments like marshes and swamps, your Agathaumas can eat Lakeweed, Reeds, Kelp, Berries, Nuts, Melons, Jellyfish, Starfish, Water Lillies, Dried Kelp and Roots.
When your Agathaumas is wet, your attacks will deal an extra  10% damage. If you attack an opponent that is wet, your attacks will deal a bonus additional 10% damage to them.
This ability can only be used when swimming, activating this ability will dash you forward a short distance, dealing knockback and moderate damage to any creatures hit by your legs during the dash
Grants nearby group members +15% Swim Speed, doubled bucking strength, and increased Swim Stamina. Does not affect Agathaumas.
Increases damage by 10% and armor by 10% to yourself and any Ceratopsians in your group within 50 meters. Stacks up to 4 times.
Gain a 10% armor increase for 30 seconds for each hit recieved while using Sol Shield. Stacks up to 5 times

When wet, gain the ability to charge forward in a line, causing damage to anything that you hit. Upon hitting an opponent, their turn radius is worsened and movement speed is decreased by 10% for 5 seconds.

Only usable when wet. A stacking roar that must be maintained, which upon activation has all non grouped members nearby have a 10% faster Oxygen Drain. Additionally, provides nearby grouped members 5% improved buck strength. Stacking up to 5 times. Stacks last 35 seconds. This vocal ability has a 20 second roar cooldown.

Mud effects will persist 30x longer if wet. Experience throughout life in the swamplands has given you knowledge on how to keep mud on your hide longer during rainstorms and when swimming, washing away the mud much slower.
Improves your Hydro Charge's turning rate, and reduces it's Stamina Cost by 25%. Additionally, this also takes 15 seconds off of Hydro Charge's cooldown.

Adapted to rivers and seaways, your Agathaumas can eat Conches, Kelp, Fish, Lakeweed, Reeds, Clams, Jellyfish, Starfish, Water Lillies, Dried Kelp and Scallops. A bonus adaptation for this lifestyle is a slower heartrate, which results in a much slower Oxygen depletion when swimming underwater. However this adaptation boosts your metabolism, resulting in needing to eat more frequently.
A moderate damage bite that additionally on successful hit reduces your opponent’s armor by 10% for 8 seconds.

Hold down the Sol Shield button in your ability hotbar to lower your head as a shield. Negating damage from incoming attacks if they connect with the head, neck, or front of the body for up to 6 seconds. Uses stamina when activated.
Dash forward to deal high armor-piercing damage. Deals greater damage when you are covered in mud, and damage scales based on how much mud is on your hide.
An ability that quickly turns you around, dealing medium damage and knockback to those hit. Works on both land and water.

A heavy stomp with your front feet that locks you in place and soaks enemies, making them wet when struck by the AoE the stomp emits. If your Agathaumas is wet when this ability is activated, the stomp will deal a bonus 50% extra damage.
A powerful ability that swings your head once to the left and once to the right. Dealing high damage and knockback to those hit by this ability.
You will now drain the stamina of creatures latched or clamped onto you by up to 100,0% based on your wetness amount, and become heavier when wet.
Intimidate with your frill, and debuff the damage of Semi Aquatics nearby you by 25%. Additionally, their swimming turn radius is worsened by 20%. This defbuff lasts 40 seconds.
